channel.title: Jason Xi — Notes
channel.description: Notes on models, machines, and the places in between.

item.title: The Cost of Tokens Is Falling. The Cost of Bad Ideas Isn’t.
item.description: Mixture-of-experts and agents are making intelligence cheaper to run. That doesn’t make judgment cheaper. It makes judgment the point.

item.title: Teaching the Physical World to Think
item.description: The interesting part of IoT is not the dashboard. It’s the moment a small device makes a better decision on its own.

item.title: A Small Site, on Purpose
item.description: No framework, no build step, no database. A personal website should outlive the tools that made it.

item.title: The View From Above
item.description: A DJI Mini 3, an Action 3, and the quiet lesson that perspective is a way of thinking.

item.title: What Co-Founding SinoFlare Taught Me About Research
item.description: A small group of people who take your half-formed idea seriously is an underrated research instrument.

item.title: Learning Three Languages While Learning Everything Else
item.description: A Grade 9 student’s notes on learning English as infrastructure, Japanese and Korean as play, and why the struggle is the point.
